problem_type: Result presenters must preserve canonical model usability
symptom: External AI is told that a model is usable merely because its credential is configured.
direct_cause: The model-list presenter groups and counts rows by keyStatus instead of the existing usable flag.
class_root: A presentation boundary re-derives a domain fact using an incomplete proxy.
affected_population: Configured models whose executor or setup is unavailable
Rows with no verified usable fact, across all MCP hosts and locales
entry_points: nomi_read target=models through the shared SDK server
Model-list text, row labels, counts and next actions
internal_only_reason: This is an internal projection invariant: modelSpecRead supplies canonical usable rows and statusReason, so no external standard or dependency determines whether a row can be recommended.
invariants: Only rows with usable === true enter the usable group or increment its count.
Unavailable rows remain visible with their reason.
No usable models with configured credentials points to model inspection, not credential replacement.
Structured model rows pass through unchanged.

door_reduction.why_not: Content assembly calls the common tool presenter, which delegates to the sole model-list presenter. Its reference tag helper preserves existing reference capability labels. These are sequential stages of one result path, not competing usability producers.

generality_proof: Every MCP transport reaches assembleToolResultContent and buildToolOutcome; both locales and every model row use one presenter that consumes the canonical usability flag.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Project every model-list label, group, count and next action from canonical usable rows.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: False usable with keyStatus ok is excluded and retains statusReason in both locales.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: buildListModelsOutcome: rows without a usable fact
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Missing usable is treated as unavailable instead of inferred from credentials.

recurrence.reason: Any future model, executor failure, host or locale can repeat the same proxy-based mistake.
same_class_scan: door-map buildListModelsOutcome buildToolOutcome found the local model presenter call and mcpResultPayload.ts as the content assembly caller.
assembleToolResultContent is called by the shared SDK server in mcpProtocol.ts.
Read modelSpecRead.listModelSpecRows and ModelAvailabilityFacts; inspect model-list and locale tests.

prevention.invariant: Canonical usable is the only admission criterion for recommendation groups and counts.
prevention.failure_mode: False or absent usable stays unavailable; configured credentials do not override it.
prevention.strategy: Delete credential-based usability derivation at the common result presenter and use usable === true for all presentation decisions.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove keyStatus-based usable grouping, counting and success labels; keep keyStatus only for credential-related explanations.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency controls this invariant; the existing model-row producer already supplies the canonical fact.

migration: No schema, stored data or tool changes. Existing hosts receive the corrected projection on their next model-list read.
residual_risks: Actual external AI selection and model rounds remain unverified; no paid calls are authorized.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The common result presenter owns externally visible model recommendations in both locales.
